title: Remote access: install Tailscale on PC and phone (10 min)

message.text:
**To reach the site away from home (about 10 min, once):**
1. PC: `winget install Tailscale.Tailscale`, then sign in.
2. Phone: install the Tailscale app and sign in with the same account.
3. Tell me "Tailscale is on".

Then the site gets a private HTTPS address that only your devices can open, and the mic works on the phone with no Chrome flag. Why not a public Cloudflare tunnel: it would put Servex, which can run commands, on the open internet. Brief: /framework/ai/2026-10-01/remote-access/

**Switched to Cloudflare, as you prefer.** lew42.com is already on Cloudflare, so this is free with no new account.
1. `winget install Cloudflare.cloudflared`
2. `cloudflared tunnel login`, then pick lew42.com in the browser.

That is all. A watcher notices, and I set up `dev.lew42.com` behind a Cloudflare Access login (only you), so Servex is never public.
